This ship does actually exist, btw. One of the BC GM's had one, so that means it's got to be in the database. I can try to ask GM to get you a screenshot of it if you need.

I would not expect it to debut for a while though, as they seem to be taking their sweet time with maritime ship releases, and this ship seems seriously OP. Probably best to be cautious with that though, if they release maritime ships like this too early it can't be a good thing for PvP due to imbalance between such a ship and everything else that other people have. At least that's my opinion about it.
